title: Motor vehicle insurance rates generally.
bodyText: Except as expressly provided in this part, all premium rates for motor vehicle insurance shall comply with the provisions of the rating law contained in article 14.
bodyHtml:
PART II.  RATES AND ADMINISTRATION

 

     §431:10C-201  Motor vehicle insurance rates generally.  Except as expressly provided in this part, all premium rates for motor vehicle insurance shall comply with the provisions of the rating law contained in article 14. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
